Norris Beauty Clinic’s content production policy regarding aesthetic medicine

Norris Beauty Clinic operates with the aim of disseminating accurate and easy-to-understand information to our readers about aesthetic medicine, such as medical diets (GLP-1 receptor agonists, fat freezing, fat-dissolving injections, liposuction, etc.) and double plastic surgery.

Cosmetic treatments such as medical diets and double plastic surgery are important themes that are closely related to each individual's health condition, constitution, cost, and schedule.

We create content with an emphasis on reliability, neutrality, and safety so that our readers can calmly make choices that are suitable for them and prepare for advance counseling.

■Basic policy for content production

■Production flow

At our media, we create content through the following process.

Production flow
  1. Search needs/concerns survey
  2. Configuration design (organizing comparison standards and points to note)
  3. Writing/editing/fact checking
  4. Regular updates to the latest prices and medical system

■Regarding reliability of information

When writing articles, we use the following public institutions and highly reliable information sources.

An example of reference data for this media
  • Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare(Medical advertising guidelines/Pharmaceuticals Act related information)
  • PMDA (Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency)
  • Japan Obesity Society・Japanese Society of Aesthetic Surgery (JSAS)Related academic societies such as
  • Consumer Affairs Agency(Related to the Specified Commercial Transactions Act and the Act on Premiums and Representations)
  • Official website information of each medical institution/pharmaceutical company

In addition, we regularly review information in response to price revisions, changes in clinic hours, updated guidelines, etc.

■Commitment to neutrality and transparency

Guaranteeing neutrality and objectivity
  • Specifies not only the benefits of each treatment but also side effects, risks, and downtime.
  • Presents points to note regarding total costs and cancellation regulations (cooling-off, etc.) for free medical treatment.
  • Do not use definitive expressions such as ``always'' or ``absolutely'' regarding changes or progress that vary from person to person.
  • Information is posted based on objective facts regardless of whether there is a partnership or not.

Explaining the difference between medical diet and aesthetic slimming in Sapporo

Before choosing a clinic, consider medical diet and aesthetics.Legal/medical differencesIt is important to understand.

Although the purpose of the two is similar, ``lose weight,'' the qualifications for performing the treatment, the drugs that can be used, and the basis for the expected effects are completely different.

Differences between medical diet and esthetics and 3 points on how to choose
  • Medical dieting is a treatment in which doctors use medical dieting equipment and drugs to reduce fat cells.
  • Aesthetic slimming is a treatment that focuses on improving the constitution to increase metabolism using massage and equipment that does not require qualifications.
  • If you are aiming to improve your constitution so that it is difficult to rebound, consult a medical institution first.

Especially in Sapporo, there are medical diet clinics and beauty salons mixed together near the station, so if you rely only on advertisements and word of mouth,Choosing a facility that does not meet your goalsThere is a risk.

It's not a question of which one is better, but the facility you should choose will depend on whether you want to control your weight medically or if you are looking for relaxation as part of your daily care.

Below, we will summarize the characteristics of both medical diets and aesthetic treatments, and which one you should choose if you are aiming to improve your constitution.

Medical dieting is a treatment in which doctors use medical dieting equipment and drugs to reduce fat cells.

Medical diets are performed based on a doctor's examination and prescription, so there is no basis for their effectiveness.medical dataIt is backed by.

GLP-1 receptor agonistis a drug that enhances the function of hormones that suppress appetite, and its weight loss effect has been confirmed in clinical trials.

GLP-1 receptor agonists, which are attracting attention as a treatment for type 2 diabetes and obesity, have been found to suppress "extrinsic eating behavior" triggered by external stimuli such as the appearance and smell of food over a long period of time.

Quote:Therapeutic effects of GLP-1 receptor agonists and “habits in eating behavior” | Kyoto University Hospital

Deoxycholic acid and phosphatidylcholine used in lipolytic injections are also medically recognized ingredients that destroy and eliminate fat cells.

The doctor determines the treatment plan after confirming the patient's health condition, past medical history, and drug contraindications through an examination.Management level with safety in mindis fundamentally different from esthetics.

3 reasons to recommend a medical diet
  • The doctor will decide on the treatment plan after checking the medical examination, medical history, and contraindications.
  • Pre-treatment blood tests and interviews allow you to check for interactions with pre-existing conditions and medications.
  • A system is in place for doctors to respond even if side effects or lack of efficacy occur.

At medical institutions, blood tests and interviews are often conducted before the treatment, allowing you to check for any underlying illnesses or interactions with medications you are currently taking.

In addition, if the treatment is not effective or if side effects occur, doctors have a system in place to respond, so it can be said that medical institutions provide more thorough follow-up after the treatment.

When comparing clinics in Sapporo, check to see if the field and career history of the doctor in charge of which treatment is made public.

Aesthetic slimming is a treatment that focuses on improving the constitution to increase metabolism using massage and equipment that does not require qualifications.

Beauty salons are not medical institutions, so we do not provide prescriptions, injections, laser irradiation, etc.medical practiceIt is prohibited by law to do so.

Diagnosis is the act of independently making judgments about treatment plans, etc. from various patient information obtained through medical examinations, etc., and communicating these decisions.Acts that involve medical judgment in this way fall under the category of medical practice, so if an unqualified person performs this as a profession (with the intention of continuing to do so repeatedly), it would be a violation of Article 17 of the Medical Practitioners Act.

Quote:Regarding handling of aesthetic medicine | Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare

The services we can provide are limited to those that approach the body from outside, such as massage, heat care, and muscle stimulation using low-frequency equipment.

These have an immediate effect on swelling relief and relaxation, but they do not have the effect of reducing fat cells themselves.

What you can and cannot do at a beauty salon
  • [Possible] External approaches such as massage, thermal care, and muscle stimulation using low-frequency equipment
  • [Can] Provide instant swelling relief and relaxation effects
  • [Cannot do] Medical procedures such as drug prescriptions, injections, laser irradiation, etc.
  • [Cannot be done] Treatment that reduces fat cells themselves

Even services that call themselves ``medical esthetics'' or ``medical esthetics'' cannot provide medical treatment if a doctor is not on site. Be sure to check the doctor's enrollment and treatment details before signing a contract.

The strengths of esthetics are the ease of continuous visits and the feeling of relaxation after the treatment.

If your main goal is not to manage your weight, but instead want to relieve stiffness in your body or manage daily stress, esthetics is a suitable option.

There are some salons that recommend combining it with a medical diet,Priority of treatment and total costPlease sort it out and then consider it.

If you are aiming to improve your constitution so that it is difficult to rebound, you need to consult a medical institution.

The main reason for rebound is that if you lose weight through diet alone without reducing the number of fat cells, then once you stop restricting your diet, fat will accumulate again.

In medical dieting, fat cooling and fat dissolving injectionsPhysically and chemically reduce fat cells themselvesBecause it takes an approach that allows you to relax, it is easier to create a condition that is less likely to rebound compared to aesthetic treatments (there are individual differences, and it must be used in conjunction with lifestyle improvements).

GLP-1 receptor agonistBecause it suppresses appetite itself, it can also serve as an opportunity for people who have a habit of overeating to reconsider their eating behavior.

Comparison of approaches to improving physical condition that is difficult to rebound
  • Fat cooling/fat dissolving injection: Physically and chemically reduces fat cells, making it difficult for them to rebound.
  • GLP-1 receptor agonist: Suppresses appetite and causes people to reconsider their eating behavior, but appetite tends to return after medication is stopped.
  • Common: The effects will not last unless you also improve your lifestyle habits (diet and exercise).

However, the effects of any treatment will not last unless you also improve your lifestyle habits.

If you rely solely on the treatment and do not review your diet and exercise, there is a risk that even if the number of fat cells decreases, the remaining cells will enlarge and cause you to regain weight.

Many medical institutions offer programs that combine dietary and exercise guidance with treatment suggestions.

If you are aiming to improve your physical condition, first consult your doctor to understand the cause of your weight gain (eating habits, hormonal balance, metabolic decline, etc.) before choosing a treatment.
